quest.title: The Moonlit Watcher
quest.description: Once the camp is set up, Illuga should be able to rest for a while...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mission accomplished! Heh, looks like a whole new camp.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Yup! Even the fortifications are complete, too. Any attackers, be they monsters or otherwise, will have a hard time overcoming our defenses now.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: The lighthouse has half a month's worth of fuel supplies, so even in the event of some massive Wild Hunt assault, we should be able to hold out until reinforcements arrive.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Haha, I just... It always pays to be prepared for the worst, y'know.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Either way, guess you can take a bit of a break now that it's all done.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Right, and that's why I'll be taking a trip home first. I mean, it's been a while since I've seen my old pops.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Home? Ohhh, yeah. Paimon's gotten so used to seeing you here, she almost forgot you're actually from Piramida.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Why don't you come along? If you wouldn't mind, I'd like to host you at our place.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: We've set up a food truck here as per Paimon's suggestion, but cooking at home is more convenient all the same.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, so you'll be cooking? Well, you're in luck — 'cause Paimon never says no to a tasty meal!

talks.objective: Head to Illuga's home in Piramida

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Lakkaberry Krumkakes, Smoked Fish Steak, Berries and Fried Meat, and Nightwatch Soup... There's so much here — almost too much, even for Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Hmm... I made this according to the amount we'd usually cook for our troops at dinner. So yeah... it might be a bit much for three.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: No worries, though, just take your time. I'll need to go see my old pops in a bit, so feel free to stay until evening.

choices.text: Didn't realize you were such a talented chef!

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Well, I did cook for everyone a lot before taking up my current post. It's just that I haven't had the time recently.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: The people of Piramida come from every corner of the world, so there's a wide variety of palates to cater for. In other words, it pays to dabble.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: But since I'm not yet familiar with your preferences, I just made a bit of everything. If there's anything here you particularly like, don't hesitate to say so.

choices.text: If Paimon likes it, so do I.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's that supposed to mean! Let's get this straight — Paimon's got her eye on the Berries and Fried Meat, so don't even try fighting her for that one!

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Haha, you won't have to fight. I'll just make some more. Couldn't have my squadmates go hungry, could I?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: People can say what they want, but the look on someone's face when they eat something they enjoy never lies.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: As far as I'm concerned, nothing makes me happier than seeing people happy.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: And whether as a Lightkeeper or a chef, I'll do whatever it takes to keep them smiling.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: That might sound trivial to you, but deep down, that's all I've ever really wanted...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly! There's no way the people around you aren't grateful for what you do. Heck, they'd probably get mad hearing you talk yourself down like that!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Besides, they'd have to get in line behind the two of us!

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Thank you, hehe... Alright, I'll refrain from saying anything else unrelated to dinner. Please, enjoy your meal.

choices.text: You're doing great as it is.
As long as you're making it, I'm a fan.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Heh, there's no need for flattery. If anything, that just makes me want to find the dish you'll like the most even more.

choices.text: Don't worry, I think Paimon's got this.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well of course, hehe, that goes without saying! Can't just let a good friend's efforts go to waste! Still, Paimon didn't expect you'd be such a good cook either, Illuga.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You jump aboard the Moonwagon, and before long, you've reached Piramida...
